plugins.name: superskillret
plugins.description: Embedding-based skill retrieval. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool (ThakiCloud/SKILLRET) and injects them as context, using the ThakiCloud/SkillRet-Embedding-0.6B encoder behind a long-running local daemon. v0.2.3: commands/add.md stops intercepting empty arguments — the CLI handles default-dir scanning. v0.2.2 added PLUGIN_ROOT fix + bare-name + dir batch + skip-dup. v0.2.1 lazy-forks install.sh. v0.2.0 added /superskillret:add.
